newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr at 120 yen is appropriate level -- Nippon Life.
newsitem.headline: Dlr at 120 yen is appropriate level -- Nippon Life.

text.p: An exchange rate of around 120 yen to the dollar is an appropriate level for the Japanese currency, Josei Itoh, president of Japan's biggest life insurer Nippon Life Insurance Co, said on Thursday.
"I don't think the current rate of the yen against the dollar is too weak," Itoh told reporters. "Around 120 yen to the dollar is a fair level (for Japan)."
On Thursday, the dollar rose to a high of 123.97 yen in Tokyo trading.
Itoh was speaking at a news conference to announce that Ikuo Uno, currently vice president, will succeed him as president when Itoh becomes chairman in April.
